highlights: Pay by UPI - GPay, PhonePe, Paytm or any bank app
Live order tracking with UTR proof and history

faq.q: How fast will I get my UC?
faq.a: Orders are usually delivered within 5-15 minutes of payment verification. During peak hours it can take up to an hour. You can watch the status on your order page.

faq.q: What is a UTR and where do I find it?
faq.a: UTR (Unique Transaction Reference) is the transaction ID your UPI app shows after a successful payment. Open the payment in GPay / PhonePe / Paytm and copy the 12-digit UPI transaction ID.

faq.q: Do you need my account password or OTP?
faq.a: Never. We only need your numeric BGMI player ID and character name. Anyone asking for a password, OTP or login is a scammer - report it to us.

faq.q: I entered the wrong player ID. What now?
faq.a: Message support with your order ID right away. If the order has not been delivered yet, we will update the player ID for you.
If a payment cannot be matched to an order, we refund it to the same UPI account after verification. Delivered UC cannot be refunded.

Pay the exact amount shown - partial payments cannot be traced.
Copy the UTR / UPI transaction ID from your payment receipt.
Paste it on this page and submit. We verify and deliver your UC.
